articles.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion, report says
articles.summary: Nvidia has reportedly reached an agreement to acquire Hugging Face, highlighting the strategic value of open-source AI ecosystems and developer platforms.

articles.title: Thinking Machines Lab co-founder Barret Zoph joins Google DeepMind
articles.summary: Barret Zoph is joining Google DeepMind, another sign that competition for experienced frontier-AI researchers remains intense.

articles.title: NVIDIA reports $96.2 billion quarterly revenue as data center demand surges
articles.summary: NVIDIA reported fiscal Q2 2027 revenue of $96.2B and data center revenue of $89.0B, underscoring continued demand for AI compute infrastructure.

articles.title: OpenAI publishes update on the Hugging Face incident and the road ahead
articles.summary: OpenAI published a security update covering the Hugging Face incident and its response, putting model and infrastructure security in focus.

articles.title: OpenAI expands ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
articles.summary: OpenAI announced broader availability of ChatGPT for Teachers, continuing the push to embed generative AI in education workflows.

articles.title: OpenAI says Jalapeño chip shows strong AI inference speed and efficiency
articles.summary: OpenAI shared first results from its Jalapeño inference chip, emphasizing throughput, latency and efficiency as AI infrastructure becomes more vertically integrated.

articles.title: OpenAI outlines the full stack behind abundant intelligence
articles.summary: OpenAI described its view of the infrastructure stack required to scale AI systems, from compute and chips to software and deployment.

articles.title: Google DeepMind looks from Atari to EVE Online for the next wave of AI and games research
articles.summary: Google DeepMind is partnering with game developers to prototype experiences that can also serve as research environments for advancing AI capabilities.

articles.title: OpenAI introduces Intelligence Age
articles.summary: OpenAI introduced its Intelligence Age framing for how advanced AI may shape products, work and society.

articles.title: Anthropic explains how Claude text watermarking works
articles.summary: Anthropic described a text-watermarking approach intended to make it easier to detect when future Claude systems have contributed to generated text.

articles.title: Anthropic introduces Claude Opus 5
articles.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Opus 5, describing improvements for long-running agents, coding and professional work.

articles.title: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 3.7 Flash
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 3.7 Flash as part of its latest model updates, continuing competition around fast, general-purpose frontier models.
